0.en: The weasel's kin demands a life for a life.
0.th: ญาติของตัวกินพองเรียกชีวิตแลกชีวิต
0.vi: Họ hàng con chồn đòi mạng đổi mạng.
0.id: Keluarga musang menuntut nyawa ganti nyawa.
0.ms: Keluarga musang menuntut nyawa bayar nyawa.
0.fil: Ang kamag-anak ng weasel, buhay kapalit buhay.

1.en: So if you run over a weasel,
1.th: ถ้าขับรถทับตัวกินพอง
1.vi: Vậy nếu tông phải con chồn,

2.en: will it come for your life?
2.th: มันจะมาเอาชีวิตคืนเหรอ?
2.vi: nó sẽ đòi mạng mình à?

3.en: That depends — was it on purpose or an accident?
3.th: ขึ้นอยู่กี่ว่าตั้งใจหรือไม่ตั้งใจ
3.vi: Tuỳ xem cố ý hay vô ý.

4.th: มีอะไรต่างกัน

5.th: ถ้าไม่ตั้งใจ

6.th: เผาของไหว้ขอขมาก็พอ
6.vi: đốt đồ lễ xin lỗi là xong.
6.id: bakar sesajen dan minta maaf — cukup.
6.ms: bakar persembahan dan minta maaf — cukup.
6.fil: magsunog ka ng offering at mag sorry — okay na.

7.en: But it must come with true remorse.
7.th: แต่ต้องมีความสำนึกผิดจริงๆ
7.vi: Nhưng phải thật lòng hối cải.

8.th: แต่ถ้าตั้งใจ

9.en: then a life for a life.
9.th: ก็ชีวิตแลกชีวิต

10.en: Why is a stranger's voice inside my head?
10.th: ทำไมในหัวฉันมีเสียงของคนแปลกหน้า
10.vi: Sao trong đầu tôi có giọng nói lạ vậy?
10.id: Kenapa ada suara asing di kepalaku?
10.ms: Kenapa ada suara asing dalam kepala saya?
10.fil: Bakit may boses ng ibang tao sa utak ko?

11.en: Our bodies have every aperture open.
11.th: ร่างกายเราเปิดช่องทางครบทุกจุด
11.vi: Cơ thể ta mở đủ mọi khiếu.
11.fil: Bukas ang lahat ng passage ng katawan natin,

12.th: เมื่อเซียนเข้าสิงช่องใด
12.vi: Khi tiên linh chiếm một khiếu,
12.fil: Kapag humawak ang spirit sa isang passage,

13.en: and want to talk, this happens.
13.th: และอยากสื่อสารกับคุณ มันก็จะเป็นแบบนี้
13.vi: và muốn trò chuyện thì sẽ như vậy.
13.fil: at gusto kang kausapin, ganito mangyayari.

14.en: This is heart-sense. There's also eye-sense and ear-sense.
14.th: นี่คือทางใจ ยังมีทางตาและทางหู
14.vi: Đó là tâm thông. Còn có nhãn thông, nhĩ thông.
14.id: Itu disebut telepati. Ada juga indra mata dan telinga.
14.ms: Itu dipanggil hati-tahu. Ada juga mata-tahu dan telinga-tahu.
14.fil: 'Yan ang heart-sense. May eye-sense at ear-sense pa.

15.th: ถ้าจะพูดกับพวกเขา

16.en: just pray silently in your mind.
16.th: ก็ภาวนาเงียบๆ ในใจ
16.vi: chỉ cần lặng lẽ nhẩm trong lòng.
16.fil: dadasal ka na lang sa isip mo.

17.en: Don't mix in your own thoughts,
17.th: อย่าแทรกความคิดของตัวเอง
17.vi: Đừng trộn suy nghĩ của mình vào,
17.fil: Huwag mong ihalo ang sariling isip,

18.en: or your readings will never be accurate.
18.th: ไม่งั้นต่อไปดูหวยจะไม่แม่น
18.vi: không thì sau này bói sẽ không chuẩn.
18.id: kalau tidak, ramalanmu tak akan akurat.
18.ms: kalau tidak, nanti bacaan tak tepat.
18.fil: kundi, hindi magiging tama ang readings mo.

19.th: ทางตาคือดวงตาหยินหยาง
19.vi: Nhãn thông chính là âm dương nhãn.

20.th: ทางหูได้ยินเสียงของเซียน
20.vi: Nhĩ thông nghe được tiên linh nói.

21.en: They let you see and hear them.
21.th: ทำให้คุณเห็นและได้ยินพวกเขา
21.vi: Cho cậu thấy và nghe được họ.
21.id: Membuatmu bisa melihat dan mendengar mereka.
21.ms: Membuat awak nampak dan dengar mereka.

22.en: It all depends on your master.
22.th: ทั้งหมดขึ้นอยู่กับอาจารย์ของคุณ
22.vi: Cả đều phụ thuộc sư phụ của cậu.

23.en: How do I know which spirit is talking?
23.th: แล้วฉันจะรู้ได้ไงว่าเซียนตัวไหนพูด
23.vi: Sao tôi biết tiên linh nào đang nói?
23.id: Bagaimana aku tahu roh mana yang bicara?
23.ms: Macam mana saya tahu yang mana bercakap?
23.fil: Paano ko malalaman kung aling spirit ang nagsasalita?

24.th: เซียนจิ้งจก เซียนตัวกินพอง เซียนผี —
24.vi: Tiên hồ, tiên chồn, tiên quỷ —

25.en: each feels different when it comes over.
25.th: ความรู้สึกตอนสิงต่างกันทุกตัว
25.vi: cảm giác khi nhập thể mỗi loại một kiểu.
25.id: rasanya berbeda saat mereka masuk tubuh.
25.fil: iba-iba ang pakiramdam pag humawak sila.

26.en: You'll learn to tell them apart.
26.th: ค่อยๆ ศึกษาก็จะรู้เอง
26.vi: Lâu dần cậu sẽ phân biệt được.
